```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="no"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (a|b)*>
  <!ELEMENT a (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT b (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST root
    id ID #REQUIRED
    ref IDREF #IMPLIED
    lang CDATA #FIXED "en"
    kind (one|two|three) "one"
    nums NMTOKENS #IMPLIED>
  <!ENTITY internalEnt "some &amp; internal <b>text</b>">
  <!ENTITY % paramEnt "<!ELEMENT c (#PCDATA)>">
  %paramEnt;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
<root id="r1" ref="r1" kind="two" nums="1 2 3" xmlns:x="urn:example:ns" xmlns="urn:default:ns">
  <a>&internalEnt;</a>
  <x:b><![CDATA[<raw> data & stuff ]]]]><![CDATA[> more]]></x:b>
  <c>&#x41;&#66;&amp;lt;</c>
  <!-- comment with -- inside is illegal, so keep it simple -->
  <?custom-pi some data here?>
  <a xml:space="preserve" xml:lang="en-US">   whitespace preserved   </a>
</root>
```
